scenario_description: A missing exact package version is retained as failure, never replaced silently.
expected: The probe exits unsuccessfully and retains the requested coordinate and error.
An older default version is not substituted for the requested version.
No package approval or functional verdict is created from the failed lookup.
observed: The exact 0.9.1 probe exited with code 2 and retained a ConfigurationError evidence artifact containing the requested coordinate.
No 0.3.4 package facts or approval verdict appear in the exact-version failure artifact.
A separate unpinned probe selected 0.3.4, confirming why explicit versions must never be replaced by the provider default.
notes: PASS applies to Blackridge's exact-version guard. deps.dev itself FAILS as a source for GROBID 0.9.1 because its Maven coverage contains only 0.3.4.
